name: vanos-sweep-collector
description: Standalone Cloudflare Worker + D1 collector for E46 M3 CSL live-VANOS-sweep datalogs (Stage 121). Separate deployment and DB from the tuner.

scripts.db:list: wrangler d1 execute vanos-sweeps --remote --command "SELECT id,label,created_at,n_samples,achieved_hz FROM vanos_sweeps ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
